messages.subject: Aspect ratio below 1 in facet_wrap
parts:
Hi!

I noticed that aspect ratio (given either through opts or coord_equal) only survice faceting if they are at 1 or above. Anything below 1 is ignored. Is that intended or a bug? Is there a workaround? I collect several plots with different numbers of facets with grid.arrange() and I don't want plots with fewer facets to be resized.

Best,
Paul
